parts.title: Early Morning
parts.text: Gus, Imani, and Rafael were spending the summer on their uncle’s farm. A **rooster** crowed at sunrise to wake them up. “Time for **chores**!” called Uncle Ray. First, they walked to the big red **barn**, where the animals slept.

parts.title: Out in the Field
parts.text: Uncle Ray drove the **tractor**, and the children rode in the wagon behind it. They stopped at the **pasture**, where a **herd** of cows began to **graze** on the green grass. Imani carried a **bale** of hay to the fence. Rafael watched a **flock** of sheep walk slowly beside them.

parts.title: A Little Noise
parts.text: Suddenly a hen began to **squawk** and flap her wings. The children laughed because she was only chasing a grasshopper. Then a pony began to **gallop** across the field, kicking up dust. Near the fence stood a **scarecrow** in an old hat. Rafael said it looked as if it was waving at them.

parts.title: A Tired Happy Night
parts.text: By evening, the three friends were tired and dusty. They washed up and ate a big dinner. Imani said that farm work was harder than she had thought, but she liked it. Tomorrow they would wake up early and do it all again.
